verdict.rationale: Square is a payments and commerce platform, not an AI agent or host application, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product role. The evidence documents an official Square MCP server (square-docs-14, square-probe-4), but that is the server role and does not show Square itself connecting to external MCP servers. Nothing in the pack shows Square shipping MCP-client capability, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
